summary: Transform your community with our Mobilizing Communities for Social Change Training Course. Gain essential skills to inspire action and foster social impact.
lede: Community mobilization helps development and humanitarian practitioners organize inclusive participation and collective action around community priorities. This training is for community development staff, social workers, program teams, public-sector officers, and advocacy facilitators who need to build trust and sustain engagement. It covers assessing community dynamics, mapping stakeholders, facilitating dialogue, and planning campaigns that respond to resistance and support ongoing participation.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who regularly mobilize people and communities. It is ideal for those in community development, NGOs, public sector programs, grassroots organizations, advocacy networks, and social impact projects.
audience: Community development officers and field staff
NGO program managers and project officers
Government officers in health, education, agriculture
Leaders of CBOs and grassroots organizations
modules: Mobilizing for Behavior and Mindset Change
Community Mobilization in Development and Humanitarian Work
prerequisites: Participants should have prior experience in community engagement or development projects. Basic understanding of social dynamics and community structures is beneficial.
